The '''Parmel system''' was located in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the traitorous [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] sought refuge in the Parmel system to escape Imperial authorities upon the discovery of his defection to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was eventually [[Battle for Honor|captured]] and brought before [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for questioning and execution.

Parmel was home to the Rebel Alliance platform ''[[DS 5]]''. It was during the pursuit of Admiral Harkov and his forces that Imperial loyalists captured the facility during a pitched battle in which Harkov attempted in vain to seek refuge aboard the platform.

The Parmel system was also home to the Imperial [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] manufacturing facility [[Research]]. It was here that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] tried to steal the Defender technology to give to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after his attempted [[Zaarin insurrection|coup]] against [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Loyal Imperial forces captured the facility, but were forced to evacuate with the prototype TIEs when Zaarin tried to destroy the space platform.
